characters.name: Old Man
characters.description: An elderly musician sitting on the street corner playing a flute.
characters.visual_description: Elderly male with long white hair and beard, wearing traditional simple linen robes, sitting cross-legged on a low stool at the street corner, holding a bamboo flute to his lips, serene and peaceful expression, soft focus background.

characters.name: Young Couple
characters.description: A pair of young lovers saying goodbye under a lantern.
characters.visual_description: Young man and young woman standing close together, holding hands, gazing into each other's eyes, illuminated by the warm glow of a hanging red lantern above them, creating a romantic silhouette, semi-formal or modern casual attire.

characters.name: Children
characters.description: A group of curious kids gathered around a snack stall.
characters.visual_description: Group of three or four young children, varied heights, pointing fingers excitedly at a food stall, expressions of curiosity and delight, wearing colorful playful clothing.

locations.name: Ancient Town Street
locations.description: A bustling stone-paved street in an old town.
locations.visual_description: Wide street paved with weathered grey stone slabs, lined with traditional ancient Chinese architecture, crowded with people, warm ambient lighting from lanterns, vibrant and colorful atmosphere, cinematic shot.

locations.name: Street Corner
locations.description: A quiet corner where the old man sits.
locations.visual_description: Corner of the stone street, slightly recessed area, shadowed but illuminated by soft lantern light, stone textures, intimate setting.

props.name: Tanghulu (Candied Hawthorn)
props.description: Traditional snack on a skewer, steaming hot.

props.name: Bamboo Flute
props.description: Woodwind instrument played by the old man.
